title: InferBench: measured benchmarking of local LLM inference engines
description:
InferBench downloads, launches and benchmarks local LLM inference engines and cloud APIs from a single click, on Windows, macOS and Linux.

It detects the host hardware, derives a working configuration for each model and quantization, and then measures time-to-first-token, tokens per second, VRAM usage and answer quality on real executions — never extrapolated or synthetic numbers. Results are comparable across runs, so a Q8 versus Q4 decision is backed by data from the same machine.

InferBench also exposes the orchestrated models through a Model Context Protocol server, covering both text generation and local image generation, so any MCP client can drive them. Models, weights and measurements never leave the user's machine.

Part of Fervon.
